subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): add timeouts to model discovery requests

question: Should Amazon Bedrock discovery enforce a fixed 30-second deadline for each control-plane request, or should this provider use a different maintained latency budget?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish correct cancellation behavior, but current code and documentation do not define when a slow valid Bedrock discovery response should be treated as unavailable.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Keep the provider-local per-request deadline and existing best-effort fallback behavior.

options.title: Retune the deadline
options.body: Select a different provider-owned duration and update the focused test and transport proof to match.

options.title: Use shared policy
options.body: Replace the local constant only if maintainers identify an existing discovery-timeout contract that appropriately owns Bedrock control-plane latency.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-local per-request deadline and existing best-effort fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent plugin model-discovery centralization provides the strongest available ownership signal for this policy choice.
